notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello all,

Hotfix incoming:

Added vsync control: some people have been experiencing frame rate issues when in fullscreen mode. Playing around with the vsync settings should set you straight.

Fullscreen: now saves between games. No more setting fullscreen every time you play a new game.

Upcoming: a few art tweaks.


--Jonathan
